zh-CN.name: Impeccable
zh-CN.shortDesc: 用于设计、改版、评审、审计、打磨或为前端做动效：网站、落地页、仪表盘、应用界面、组件、原生 iOS/Android 页面，或设计系统（DESIGN.md）。新版本使用上游独立二进制启动器，可能在首次运行时下载；需自行满足平台与运行权限。可选的图像草图在设置 OPENAI_API_KEY 时可回退调用 OpenAI 图像 API，费用计入运营者自有账户。

en-US.name: Impeccable
en-US.shortDesc: Use to design, redesign, critique, audit, polish or animate a frontend: websites, landing pages, dashboards, app UI, components, native iOS/Android screens, or a design system (DESIGN.md). Uses an upstream standalone binary launcher that may download on first run; you must satisfy platform and permission requirements. Optional image sketches may fall back to the OpenAI image API when OPENAI_API_KEY is set; costs go to the operator’s own account.
